correctness.rationale: Greedy matching of a fixed scattered pattern in iid host yields independent geometric waits with GF product g_a(z), giving both exact expectation GFs by summing each distinct string once. Unique shortest unbordered border b shows w=bvb with 2|b|<=|w|; weighted series therefore (1-S)U=S-U(x²). The positive density theta(v) follows the finite-border probability limit plus a two-symbol first/last block lower bound. Analytic continuation of U(g(z)²) beyond unique positive r, and strict triangle inequality for S(z) on |z|=r, yield a unique simple dominant pole and exponentially smaller remainders. Independent brute-force host enumeration agrees with independently computed pattern-greedy expectation for binary and ternary cases; finite tests do not establish singularity claims.
